definition: [ רָתַק ] verb bind (Arabic close up and repair, sew up ; Talmud רִיתְקָא fenced enclosure ); — Pu`al Perfect 3 plural רֻתְּקוּ בַזִּקִּים Nah 3:10 her great ones were bound with fetters Niph`al Imperfect 3 masculine singular יֵרָתֵק Eccl 12:6 Qr ( ירחק Kt ), from context = be snapped, broken ; read probably יִנָּתֵק (Pfannkuche Thes and modern).
